Name: OrbitalRingLoadMessage
ZHCN:
⚠若您在主界面中看到了星环的图标、无红字报错，且科技树与原版不同，说明MOD已成功加载。
请注意，本MOD修改了大量原版内容，因此禁用了上传银河系的功能。
本MOD暂时与部分MOD完全或部分不兼容，具体点击下方按钮查看。
如果您在游玩MOD时遇到了任何问题，或者有宝贵的意见或建议，欢迎加入MOD交流群
ENUS:
⚠If you see the icon of the OrbitalRing in the main interface, with no red error message, and the technology tree is different from the original version, it means that the MOD has been successfully loaded. 
Please note that this mode modifies a lot of content, and you cannot upload the data the galaxy.
This MOD is currently fully or partially incompatible with some other MODs. Please click the button below to view the details. 
If have any issues or ideas about the mod, please join our community on Discord.

Name: BepinExVersionNotMatch
ZHCN: ⚠ BepinEx版本不为5.4.17！这会导致许多不可预知的Bug。
ENUS: ⚠ BepinEx version is not 5.4.17! This leads to many unpredictable bugs.

Name: 不兼容MOD
ZHCN:
不兼容或不推荐同开的MOD一览：

  不兼容激光砍树MOD（LaserClearing） 以及辅助MOD的加速砍树功能：会使得星环必要流程中的掉落物无法正常掉落，导致<color="#FD965ECC">无法正常进行游戏流程</color>。

  不兼容改大塔物品槽个数的MOD：会跳报错

  不推荐开GalacticScale MOD：有诸多未兼容的内容，可能出现的问题包括但不限于：
    初始行星没有煤和硫磺等资源
    其他行星资源或星球特质异常
    变动星系生成导致可能的死档。

  不推荐辅助MOD设置星际运输站状态：星环的星际运输站不可放入运输机，辅助MOD若设置建造时塞入运输机会在计算运输时导致报错 

  不推荐辅助mod初始化行星：已建造的星环和同步轨道数据不会因初始化而清空，将导致数据混乱 

  不推荐使用其他mod添加的星际运输站：无法正常使用运输机收发物品

  不推荐使用星球矿机（PlanetMinerFast）：会导致原本无限的资源深层熔岩挖空

  不兼容联机（NebulaMultiplayerMod）：主机与接入玩家的制造台插件不同步

  不兼容weaver mod

  不兼容DSPOptimizations mod：自回填配方无法生效

  不推荐深空来敌 TheyComeFromVoidmod：部分对配方有影响的元驱动会导致报错
ENUS:
List of incompatible or not recommended mods for simultaneous use:

  Incompatible with LaserClearing and the accelerated tree-cutting function of auxiliary mods: It will prevent the normal drop of items in the necessary process of the Orbital Ring, resulting in <color="#FD965ECC">the inability to progress through the game normally</color>. 

 Incompatible with mods that increase the number of item slots in the tower: It will cause errors. 

 It is not recommended to enable the GalacticScale mod: There are many incompatible contents, and possible issues include but are not limited to: 
 The initial planet lacks resources such as coal and sulfur. 
 Other planet resources or planet traits are abnormal. 
 Changing the galaxy generation may lead to a deadlock. 

 It is not recommended to set the status of interstellar transport stations in auxiliary mods: The interstellar transport stations of the Orbital Ring cannot accommodate transport machines. If auxiliary mods are set to insert transport machines during construction, it will cause errors during transportation calculation. 

  It is not recommended to initialize planets with auxiliary mods: the data of constructed rings and synchronous orbits will not be cleared due to initialization, which will lead to data confusion 

 It is not recommended to use interstellar transport stations added by other mods: They cannot be used to receive and send items with transport machines normally

 It is not recommended to use PlanetMinerFast: it can lead to the depletion of the originally unlimited deep lava resources

  Incompatible with NebulaMultiplayerMod: The crafting table plugins of the host and connected players are not synchronized

  Incompatible with weaver mod

  Incompatible with DSPOptimizations mod: Self-backfilling recipes cannot take effect 

  Do not recommend using TheyComeFromVoid mod: Some meta-drivers that affect recipes may cause errors.
